name: Goa
tagline: Beaches, Portuguese lanes and long lazy sunsets
best_time: November to February, when the weather is dry and pleasant
highlights: Sunset at Vagator or Chapora Fort
Walking the Latin Quarter of Fontainhas in Panaji
The quieter beaches of South Goa like Palolem and Agonda
Spice plantations and old churches around Old Goa
stay_areas: Anjuna / Vagator for cafés and nightlife
Panaji for heritage and easy transfers
getting_there: Fly into Goa (Dabolim or Mopa) or take an overnight train to Madgaon or Thivim.
tip: Rent a scooter for the day — beaches are spread out and taxis add up quickly.

name: Agra
tagline: The Taj Mahal and the Mughal heartland
highlights: Mehtab Bagh for sunset views of the Taj
stay_areas: Taj Ganj for walking access to the Taj
getting_there: About 2–3 hours from Delhi by express train or the Yamuna Expressway; Agra also has a small airport.
tip: The Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays — plan around it.

name: Manali
tagline: Pine forests, snow peaks and the road to Lahaul
best_time: March to June for pleasant weather, December to February for snow
highlights: Old Manali cafés and the Hadimba Temple
Solang Valley for paragliding and skiing
A day trip through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu
stay_areas: Vashisht for hot springs and views
getting_there: Overnight Volvo buses from Delhi are the most popular option; the nearest airport is Bhuntar near Kullu.
tip: Check Rohtang Pass permits and road status a day before — they change with the weather.

name: Bali
tagline: Rice terraces, temples and surf beaches
highlights: Uluwatu Temple and Kecak dance at sunset
getting_there: Fly into Ngurah Rai International Airport (Denpasar); there are direct flights from some Indian cities.
tip: Traffic is heavy — base yourself in two areas rather than doing day trips from one.

name: Bangkok
tagline: Temples, street food and rooftop nights
highlights: A canal boat ride through Thonburi
getting_there: Fly into Suvarnabhumi; there are many direct flights from India.
tip: Use the river ferries — they beat the traffic and are cheap.

name: Kochi
tagline: Chinese fishing nets, spice markets and colonial lanes
highlights: Chinese fishing nets at Fort Kochi
getting_there: Cochin International Airport has direct flights from most Indian cities.
tip: Use the cheap public ferries between Ernakulam and Fort Kochi.

name: Jaipur
tagline: The Pink City of forts, palaces and bazaars
highlights: Amber Fort early in the morning
Hawa Mahal and the City Palace
Shopping for block prints at Johari and Bapu Bazaar
stay_areas: Bani Park for quieter boutique hotels
getting_there: Jaipur has an international airport and frequent trains and buses from Delhi (about 5 hours by road).
tip: Buy the composite ticket — it covers most major monuments and saves money.

name: Mumbai
tagline: The city of dreams, street food and sea-facing promenades
getting_there: Mumbai's international airport and rail stations connect to the whole country.
tip: Use local trains outside rush hours — they're the fastest way across the city.

name: Phuket
tagline: Andaman Sea beaches and island hopping
highlights: Phang Nga Bay and James Bond Island
getting_there: Fly into Phuket International Airport; direct flights run from several Indian cities.
tip: Book island tours that leave early to beat the crowds.

name: Dubai
tagline: Skyscrapers, desert safaris and souks
highlights: Old Dubai: abra ride and the Gold Souk
getting_there: Many direct flights from India to Dubai International.
tip: The Metro is clean, cheap and connects most major sights.

name: Udaipur
tagline: Lakes, palaces and rooftop sunsets
highlights: A boat ride on Lake Pichola
food: Malpua from the old city sweet shops
stay_areas: Fateh Sagar area for calm stays
getting_there: Fly to Maharana Pratap Airport or take a train from Delhi, Jaipur or Ahmedabad.
tip: Book a lake-view room — it is what makes Udaipur special.

name: Kolkata
tagline: Colonial grandeur, sweets and the soul of Bengal
highlights: Howrah Bridge and the flower market
stay_areas: Park Street for food and nightlife
getting_there: Kolkata's airport and Howrah/Sealdah stations are well connected.
tip: Visit during Durga Puja (Sept/Oct) for the city's biggest festival.

name: Rishikesh
tagline: Yoga capital and white-water rafting on the Ganga
best_time: September to November and February to May
highlights: Evening Ganga aarti at Triveni Ghat or Parmarth Niketan
Walking across Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula
stay_areas: Laxman Jhula area for river views
getting_there: Fly to Dehradun (Jolly Grant), about 45 minutes away, or take a train or bus to Haridwar/Rishikesh.
tip: Rafting is usually closed during the monsoon months — plan around it.

name: Singapore
tagline: Gardens, hawker food and a skyline by the bay
best_time: Year-round; February to April is often driest
highlights: Gardens by the Bay light show
Hawker centres like Maxwell and Lau Pa Sat
getting_there: Direct flights from most major Indian cities to Changi Airport.
tip: Eat at hawker centres — great food at a fraction of restaurant prices.

name: Hanoi & Ha Long Bay
tagline: Old Quarter streets and limestone bays
highlights: Overnight cruise on Ha Long or Lan Ha Bay
stay_areas: A cruise boat for one night
getting_there: Fly into Noi Bai International Airport; direct flights operate from India.
tip: Pick a Lan Ha Bay cruise for fewer boats than central Ha Long.

name: Hyderabad
tagline: Biryani, pearls and Nizami palaces
getting_there: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport has flights from across India.
tip: Go to Golconda in the late afternoon and stay for the views at sunset.

name: Leh-Ladakh
tagline: High passes, blue lakes and Buddhist monasteries
stay_areas: Leh town near the Main Bazaar
getting_there: Fly into Leh, or drive via the Manali–Leh or Srinagar–Leh highways in summer.
tip: Spend your first 48 hours in Leh resting to acclimatise to the altitude.

name: Jodhpur
tagline: The Blue City beneath Mehrangarh Fort
highlights: Walking the blue lanes of Brahmpuri
getting_there: Jodhpur has an airport and good rail links with Delhi and Jaipur.
tip: Book a rooftop room in the old city — the fort view at night is unforgettable.

name: Kathmandu
tagline: Ancient squares and the gateway to the Himalaya
best_time: October to November and March to April
highlights: Mountain flight or a trip to Nagarkot
getting_there: Short flights from Delhi and other Indian cities.
tip: Add Pokhara for lakes and easy Annapurna views.

name: Maldives
tagline: Overwater villas and house reefs
stay_areas: Maafushi / Thulusdhoo for budget local islands
getting_there: Direct flights from several Indian cities to Malé, then speedboat or seaplane.
tip: Local islands are a budget-friendly alternative to resorts.

name: Munnar
tagline: Rolling tea estates in the Western Ghats
getting_there: Kochi airport is about 4 hours away by road.
tip: Combine Munnar with Alleppey and Kochi for a classic Kerala loop.

name: Pushkar
tagline: A holy lake town on the edge of the desert
getting_there: About 15 km from Ajmer railway station; Jaipur airport is about 3 hours away.
tip: Pushkar is a holy town — alcohol and meat are not served.

name: Alleppey
tagline: Houseboats drifting through Kerala's backwaters
highlights: Village walks along the paddy fields
food: Banana chips fresh from the fryer
getting_there: About 1.5–2 hours by road from Kochi airport; Alappuzha also has a railway station.
tip: Choose a houseboat with a shared-kitchen menu agreed in advance to avoid surprise charges.

name: Pokhara
tagline: Lakeside calm under the Annapurnas
best_time: October to November and March to April
getting_there: Short flight or a scenic road trip from Kathmandu.
tip: Pokhara is the starting point for the Annapurna and Poon Hill treks.

name: Sri Lanka
tagline: Tea hills, ancient cities and southern beaches
best_time: December to March for the south and west coasts
getting_there: Short direct flights from Chennai, Delhi, Mumbai and other cities to Colombo.
tip: Reserve the Kandy–Ella train seats early, or try the unreserved carriage for the view.

name: Ranthambore
tagline: Tigers among ancient ruins
best_time: October to June (park closed in monsoon)
getting_there: Sawai Madhopur station is on the Delhi–Mumbai line; Jaipur airport is about 3 hours away.
tip: Safari permits sell out — book on the official portal well ahead.

name: Varanasi
tagline: India's oldest living city on the Ganga
highlights: Sunrise boat ride along the ghats
Sarnath, where the Buddha gave his first sermon
stay_areas: Assi Ghat for cafés and calm
getting_there: Fly into Lal Bahadur Shastri Airport or take one of many trains to Varanasi Junction.
tip: Hire a boat at dawn rather than evening — the light and the quiet are worth the early alarm.

name: Mount Abu
tagline: Rajasthan's only hill station
food: Corn on the cob by the lake
getting_there: Abu Road station is 28 km away; Udaipur airport is about 3.5 hours by road.
tip: Photography is not allowed inside the Dilwara Temples.

name: Krabi
tagline: Limestone cliffs and emerald water
getting_there: Fly to Krabi directly or via Bangkok.
tip: Railay is reachable only by long-tail boat — pack light.

name: Kuala Lumpur
tagline: Twin towers, street food and rainforest
best_time: December to February and June to August
stay_areas: Bukit Bintang for food and shopping
getting_there: Direct flights from many Indian cities.
tip: Visit Batu Caves early morning to avoid heat and crowds.

name: Darjeeling
tagline: Tea gardens, toy trains and Kanchenjunga views
best_time: March to May and October to December
highlights: Sunrise over Kanchenjunga from Tiger Hill
A ride on the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway
stay_areas: Near the Mall / Chowrasta for walkability
getting_there: Fly to Bagdogra or take a train to New Jalpaiguri, then about 3 hours by road.
tip: Leave for Tiger Hill around 4 AM — the road gets jammed close to sunrise.

name: Rann of Kutch
tagline: The white salt desert under a full moon
highlights: White Rann at sunset and full moon
stay_areas: Dhordo tent city during Rann Utsav
getting_there: Fly or take a train to Bhuj; Dhordo is about 1.5 hours by road.
tip: A permit is needed for the White Rann — it's usually available at the Bhirandiyara checkpost.

name: Andaman Islands
tagline: Turquoise water, coral reefs and white sand
highlights: Cellular Jail light and sound show
getting_there: Fly to Port Blair, then take a ferry to Havelock and Neil.
tip: Book inter-island ferries early in peak season — they sell out.

name: Chiang Mai
tagline: Temples, night markets and mountain air
getting_there: Fly from Bangkok (about an hour) or take the overnight train.
tip: Choose elephant sanctuaries that don't offer riding.

name: Bhutan
tagline: Dzongs, prayer flags and Tiger's Nest
best_time: March to May and September to November
stay_areas: Paro for the Tiger's Nest hike
getting_there: Fly to Paro, or travel overland via Phuentsholing.
tip: Check current entry fees and permit rules before booking — they are updated from time to time.

name: Khajuraho
tagline: Thousand-year-old temples carved in stone
stay_areas: Near the Western Group of Temples
getting_there: Khajuraho has a small airport and a railway station.
tip: Hire an approved guide — the carvings make far more sense with context.

name: Hampi
tagline: Boulder landscapes and the ruins of Vijayanagara
highlights: Vittala Temple and the stone chariot
stay_areas: Hampi Bazaar area for access to ruins
Hippie Island (Virupapur Gaddi) for chilled stays
getting_there: Overnight trains or buses to Hosapete (Hospet), about 30 minutes away.
tip: Rent a bicycle — the ruins are spread over a large area.

name: Ajanta & Ellora
tagline: Rock-cut caves and ancient Buddhist murals
stay_areas: Aurangabad (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar) city as a base
getting_there: Fly or take a train to Aurangabad; Ellora is about 30 km and Ajanta about 100 km away.
tip: Ellora is closed on Tuesdays and Ajanta on Mondays.

name: Langkawi
tagline: Rainforest islands and a sky bridge
highlights: Langkawi Sky Bridge and cable car
getting_there: Fly via Kuala Lumpur or Penang.
tip: Langkawi is duty-free — good for chocolates and gear.

name: Istanbul
tagline: Two continents, a thousand years of history
best_time: April to June and September to November
highlights: Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque
getting_there: Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai to Istanbul Airport.
tip: Get an Istanbulkart for trams, metro and ferries.

name: Pondicherry
tagline: French Quarter streets on the Bay of Bengal
getting_there: About 3 hours by road from Chennai airport.
tip: Rent a bicycle to explore White Town at an easy pace.

name: Mysuru
tagline: Palaces, silk and sandalwood
highlights: Mysore Palace lit up on Sundays
getting_there: About 3 hours from Bengaluru by train or road.
tip: The palace is illuminated on Sunday evenings and during Dasara.

name: Shimla
tagline: The colonial summer capital in the hills
best_time: March to June, and December to January for snow
highlights: Day trips to Kufri and Mashobra
getting_there: Drive from Chandigarh (about 3.5 hours) or take the toy train from Kalka.
tip: Most of central Shimla is pedestrian-only — pack light.

name: Ho Chi Minh City
tagline: Scooters, street food and the Mekong Delta
getting_there: Direct and one-stop flights from India.
tip: Cross streets slowly and steadily — scooters flow around you.

name: Tbilisi
tagline: Sulphur baths, wine and Caucasus day trips
best_time: May to June and September to October
highlights: Old Town and the Narikala Fortress cable car
getting_there: Connecting flights from India via the Gulf or Istanbul.
tip: Book the Kazbegi trip as a shared tour — it is far cheaper than a private car.

name: Chikmagalur
tagline: Where India's coffee story began
getting_there: About 5 hours by road from Bengaluru; Mangaluru is the nearest airport.
tip: Stay on a working coffee estate and ask for a plantation walk.

name: Coorg
tagline: Misty coffee estates in the Kodagu hills
getting_there: Mangaluru and Bengaluru are the nearest airports; Mysuru is about 3 hours by road.
tip: Stay in a plantation homestay — the home-cooked Kodava food is the highlight.

name: Gokarna
tagline: Goa's quieter, wilder neighbour
highlights: Beach trek: Kudle to Om to Half Moon to Paradise
getting_there: Train to Gokarna Road station or about 3 hours by road from Goa airport.
tip: Carry cash and a torch for the beach trek.

name: Da Nang & Hoi An
tagline: Lantern-lit old town and long beaches
highlights: Hoi An Ancient Town at night
Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills
getting_there: Fly to Da Nang International Airport.
tip: Get clothes tailored in Hoi An — it's quick and good value.

name: Siem Reap
tagline: Sunrise over Angkor Wat
getting_there: Fly into Siem Reap Angkor International Airport, usually via Bangkok or Singapore.
tip: A multi-day temple pass lets you avoid rushing — hire a tuk-tuk for the day.

name: Amritsar
tagline: The Golden Temple and Punjab's best food
highlights: Golden Temple at night and at dawn
stay_areas: Near the Golden Temple for early visits
getting_there: Amritsar has an international airport and is well connected by train from Delhi.
tip: Visit the Golden Temple twice — once at night and once early morning.

name: Varkala
tagline: Red cliffs over the Arabian Sea
stay_areas: North Cliff for views and cafés
getting_there: About 1 hour from Thiruvananthapuram airport; Varkala has a railway station.
tip: Currents can be strong — swim only where lifeguards are present.

name: Jaisalmer
tagline: The Golden City at the edge of the Thar
highlights: Camel safari and desert camp at Sam or Khuri
stay_areas: Inside or below the fort for atmosphere
getting_there: Overnight trains from Delhi and Jaipur; the airport has limited seasonal flights.
tip: Choose a desert camp away from the crowded dunes for a quieter night sky.

name: Hong Kong
tagline: Harbour skylines, dim sum and island hikes
getting_there: Direct flights from several Indian cities.
tip: Get an Octopus card for transport and convenience stores.

name: Tokyo
tagline: Neon, temples and the world's best food scene
best_time: March to May and October to November
highlights: Day trip to Mount Fuji area
getting_there: Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai.
tip: A prepaid IC card (Suica or Pasmo) makes trains effortless.

name: Kanyakumari
tagline: India's southern tip, where three seas meet
stay_areas: Near the sea front for sunrise views
getting_there: About 2 hours from Thiruvananthapuram airport; trains run from many cities.
tip: On full-moon evenings you can see sunset and moonrise at the same time.

name: Gangtok
tagline: Monasteries, mountain lakes and Himalayan views
best_time: March to May and October to December
getting_there: Fly to Bagdogra or take a train to New Jalpaiguri, then about 4 hours by road.
tip: Permits for Nathula and North Sikkim are arranged through registered agents — book a day ahead.

name: Madurai
tagline: A living temple city of towering gopurams
getting_there: Madurai has an airport and is well connected by rail.
tip: Dress modestly and leave phones at the counter — they aren't allowed inside the temple.

name: Seoul
tagline: Palaces, K-culture and late-night food
best_time: April to June and September to November
getting_there: One-stop flights from India.
tip: Rent a hanbok — entry to the main palaces is often free when you wear one.

name: Abu Dhabi
tagline: Grand mosques, museums and theme parks
getting_there: Direct flights from many Indian cities.
tip: Dress modestly for the Grand Mosque — robes are provided if needed.

name: Shillong & Meghalaya
tagline: Living root bridges and the wettest hills on earth
highlights: Double-decker living root bridge at Nongriat
food: Local cafés and live music in Shillong
getting_there: Fly to Guwahati, then about 3 hours by road to Shillong.
tip: The Nongriat trek has thousands of steps — start early and carry water.

name: Mahabalipuram
tagline: Pallava stone temples by the sea
getting_there: About 1.5 hours by road from Chennai airport.
tip: Combine it with Pondicherry on a single road trip down the East Coast Road.

name: Srinagar
tagline: Houseboats, shikaras and Mughal gardens
best_time: April to October, and winter for snow
highlights: Day trips to Gulmarg and Pahalgam
stay_areas: Houseboats on Dal or Nigeen Lake
getting_there: Fly directly to Srinagar from major Indian cities.
tip: Nigeen Lake houseboats are calmer than the busy parts of Dal Lake.

name: Muscat
tagline: Mountains, wadis and a calm Arabian coast
getting_there: Short direct flights from many Indian cities.
tip: Rent a car — Oman's best sights are outside the city.

name: Baku
tagline: Old walls and Flame Towers on the Caspian
best_time: April to June and September to October
getting_there: Direct and one-stop flights from Delhi.
tip: Take the funicular to Highland Park for the city view.

name: Wayanad
tagline: Misty forests, caves and waterfalls
getting_there: About 3 hours by road from Kozhikode (Calicut) airport.
tip: Trek permits for Chembra Peak are limited — start early.

name: Ooty
tagline: The Nilgiris' classic hill station
getting_there: Coimbatore airport is about 3 hours away; the toy train runs from Mettupalayam.
tip: Book the toy train seats well ahead — they fill up fast.

name: Lakshadweep
tagline: India's coral islands in the Arabian Sea
getting_there: Fly from Kochi to Agatti, or take a ship from Kochi.
tip: An entry permit is required — check the current rules with the Lakshadweep administration before booking.

name: Almaty
tagline: A green city at the foot of snowy peaks
best_time: May to September, or December to March for skiing
getting_there: Direct flights from Delhi.
tip: Kolsai and Kaindy lakes make a great two-day trip.

name: Mauritius
tagline: Lagoons, mountains and a familiar Indian touch
getting_there: Direct flights from Mumbai and other Indian cities.
tip: Rent a car — the island is easy to drive and distances are short.

name: Kasol
tagline: The Parvati Valley's riverside backpacker base
best_time: March to June and September to November
getting_there: Overnight bus from Delhi to Bhuntar, then a local bus or taxi.
tip: Carry cash — ATMs in the valley often run dry.

name: Kaziranga
tagline: One-horned rhinos on the Brahmaputra floodplains
best_time: November to April (park closed in monsoon)
highlights: Jeep safari in the Central Range
getting_there: About 4–5 hours by road from Guwahati; Jorhat airport is closer.
tip: Book the morning safari — the light and animal sightings are best then.

name: Tawang
tagline: High-altitude monasteries and frozen lakes
best_time: March to June and September to November
getting_there: A long scenic drive from Guwahati or Tezpur, usually over two days via Dirang.
tip: Indian visitors need an Inner Line Permit — apply online before you go.

name: Seychelles
tagline: Granite boulders and powder-white beaches
best_time: April to May and October to November
highlights: Anse Source d'Argent on La Digue
Snorkelling at Sainte Anne Marine Park
stay_areas: Praslin and La Digue for beaches
getting_there: Flights via the Gulf or direct seasonal flights from India.
tip: Rent a bicycle on La Digue — it's the main way to get around.

name: Paris
tagline: Art, cafés and the Eiffel Tower
best_time: April to June and September to October
stay_areas: Near major Metro lines for convenience
getting_there: Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai.
tip: Book museum and Eiffel Tower tickets online to skip queues.

name: Spiti Valley
tagline: A cold desert of monasteries and moonscapes
getting_there: Drive via Shimla–Kinnaur (open most of the year) or via Manali when the passes are open.
tip: Fuel stations are rare — fill up at Kaza and carry cash.

name: McLeodganj
tagline: Little Lhasa in the Dhauladhar hills
best_time: March to June and September to November
getting_there: Fly to Dharamshala (Gaggal) or take an overnight bus from Delhi.
tip: Start the Triund trek early to beat the afternoon clouds.

name: Mussoorie
tagline: The Queen of the Hills above Dehradun
best_time: March to June and September to November
highlights: Mall Road and Camel's Back Road
getting_there: About 1.5 hours by road from Dehradun.
tip: Walk up to Landour for the hill station Mussoorie used to be.

name: Swiss Alps (Interlaken)
tagline: Lakes, trains and Alpine peaks
best_time: June to September, or December to March for snow
getting_there: Fly to Zurich, then about 2 hours by train.
tip: Check rail passes — they can save a lot on mountain trains.

name: Amsterdam
tagline: Canals, bikes and world-class museums
best_time: April to May (tulip season) and June to September
getting_there: Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai.
tip: Book the Anne Frank House online — tickets sell out weeks ahead.

name: Nainital
tagline: A lake town ringed by hills
best_time: March to June and October to December
highlights: Day trip to Bhimtal and Sattal
getting_there: Kathgodam railway station is about 1.5 hours away; Pantnagar is the nearest airport.
tip: Weekends get crowded — visit midweek if you can.

name: Auli
tagline: Ski slopes with Nanda Devi views
best_time: December to March for snow, April to June for meadows
getting_there: Rishikesh to Joshimath is a long mountain drive, then cable car or road to Auli.
tip: Check road and ropeway status before travelling in winter.

name: Lonavala
tagline: Monsoon waterfalls between Mumbai and Pune
best_time: June to September for the monsoon, October to February for pleasant weather
getting_there: About 2 hours from Mumbai and 1 hour from Pune by road or train.
tip: Avoid monsoon weekends if you dislike crowds.

name: London
tagline: Royal history, free museums and theatre
highlights: Tower of London and Tower Bridge
getting_there: Many direct flights from Indian cities.
tip: Tap a contactless card on the Tube — daily fares are capped.
